GABRIEL.d: Gabriel India Limited manufactures ride control products like shock absorbers and struts for the automotive industry. Its main customers are leading two-wheeler, passenger vehicle, and commercial vehicle manufacturers.

GAIL.d: GAIL (India) Limited owns and operates a vast network of natural gas pipelines across India for transmission and marketing. It serves city gas distribution entities, power plants, and industrial consumers as a state-owned enterprise.

GALLANTT.d: Gallantt Ispat Limited manufactures steel and generates power, focusing on TMT bars and steel products. It operates integrated manufacturing facilities primarily serving the domestic construction sector.

GILLETTE.d: Gillette India manufactures and sells grooming products, including blades, razors, and toiletries. The company operates as a subsidiary of Procter & Gamble.

GLAND.d: Gland Pharma develops and manufactures injectable generic pharmaceuticals and sterile products for global markets. It operates through business-to-business models serving pharmaceutical marketing companies.

GLAXO.d: GlaxoSmithKline Pharmaceuticals manufactures and distributes prescription medicines and vaccines in India. It is a subsidiary of the global healthcare company Haleon and GSK group, serving patients and healthcare providers.

GLENMARK.d: Glenmark Pharmaceuticals develops, manufactures, and markets generic and branded prescription drugs across various therapeutic areas. It serves global markets including India, the US, and Europe.

GMDCLTD.d: Gujarat Mineral Development Corporation mines lignite, bauxite, and fluorspar, supplying key industrial minerals primarily to power and chemical sectors. It is a state-owned enterprise controlled by the Government of Gujarat.

GMRAIRPORT.d: GMR Airports develops, operates, and maintains major commercial airports in India and internationally. It serves airlines, passengers, and cargo operators by providing aviation infrastructure and related services.

GODFRYPHLP.d: Godfrey Phillips India Limited manufactures and distributes cigarettes, tobacco products, and retail merchandise. It produces well-known cigarette brands and operates retail convenience stores in India.

GODREJAGRO.d: Godrej Agrovet Limited manufactures animal feed, crop protection products, and dairy goods, alongside operating in poultry and oil palm plantations. Its main customers are farmers and agricultural enterprises across India.

GODREJCP.d: Godrej Consumer Products Limited manufactures and distributes personal and household care products. Its portfolio includes soaps, hair color, and insecticides sold in global markets.

GODREJIND.d: Godrej Industries Limited operates in diverse sectors including oleochemicals, crop protection, dairy, and real estate. It serves agricultural, industrial, and consumer markets through its various subsidiaries and businesses.

GODREJPROP.d: Godrej Properties develops residential, commercial, and township projects in major Indian cities. The real estate developer is a subsidiary of Godrej Industries.

GPIL.d: Godawari Power and Ispat produces iron ore pellets, sponge iron, steel billets, and generates captive renewable power. It caters to domestic steel manufacturers and industrial consumers.

GRANULES.d: Granules India manufactures active pharmaceutical ingredients, pharmaceutical formulation intermediates, and finished dosages. It exports products to pharmaceutical companies globally.

GRAPHITE.d: Graphite India manufactures carbon and graphite electrodes used primarily in electric arc furnace steel mills. It is one of the largest producers of graphite electrodes globally.

GRASIM.d: Grasim Industries Limited manufactures viscose staple fiber, chlor-alkali, and paints, serving textile and industrial sectors. It is a flagship company of the Aditya Birla Group.

GRSE.d: Garden Reach Shipbuilders and Engineers builds and repairs commercial and naval vessels. It is a state-owned enterprise primarily serving the Indian Navy and Coast Guard.

GRWRHITECH.d: Garware Hi-Tech Films Limited manufactures polyester films, sun control films, and specialty plastic products for automotive and architectural applications.

GVT&D.d: GE Vernova T&D India provides power transmission and distribution products, solutions, and systems. It serves power generation companies, utilities, and heavy industries across India.
